name: list_available_services
description: The chatbot provides a list of services available in the Comunidad de Madrid for citizens.

outputs.description: Services include Sistema de Respuesta Vocal Interactiva (I.V.R), Servicio tracking de la app My112, Localización de llamadas móviles de alta precisión (AML), Mi Emergencia 112, Sistema de alertas públicas (ES_ALERT)

name: provide_service_tracking_info
description: The chatbot delivers specific information about the 'Servicio tracking de la app My112.'

outputs.description: Detailed features of the tracking service such as localizing users in emergencies and sharing location with emergency services.

name: provide_public_alert_info
description: Describes the features and functionality of the public alert system, including how citizens can receive notifications during emergencies and the importance of enabling app notifications.

outputs.description: Information on how alerts are activated, what types of notifications citizens will receive during emergencies, how these alerts are broadcasted, the public alert system, and the requirement for users to enable app notifications for receiving mass alerts and relevant safety recommendations.

name: provide_information_on_medical_choice_right
description: Gives details on the right of free medical choice, including how citizens can choose their healthcare professionals.

outputs.description: Information on choosing family doctors, pediatricians, nurses, hospitals, and specialists

name: prompt_for_online_medical_choice_steps
description: Informs the user of the specific steps to exercise the right of free medical choice online.

outputs.description: Step-by-step instructions for selecting a medical professional online.

name: provide_information_on_waiting_lists_and_satisfaction
description: Presents information on how to check waiting lists and satisfaction indicators for health centers and hospitals online.

outputs.description: Information on surgical waiting lists, outpatient consultations, diagnostic tests, and user satisfaction indicators.

name: provide_child_vaccination_calendar_link
description: Provides a direct link to the child vaccination calendar for citizens in the Comunidad de Madrid.

outputs.description: Direct URL to the official vaccination calendar PDF.

name: prompt_for_configuring_public_alerts
description: The chatbot provides step-by-step instructions on how to configure the My112 app to receive public alerts.

name: provide_technical_support_guidance
description: The chatbot informs the user on what to do in case of technical issues with the My112 app, including suggestions to check the help section or contact the phone operator.

outputs.description: Guidance on troubleshooting steps for technical issues with the app.

name: list_additional_app_functions
description: Provides a list of other functions available in the My112 app in addition to tracking.

outputs.description: Functions include Real-time Tracking, Notifications, and Quick Access.

name: provide_incident_location_visualization_details
description: Describes how the incident location is visualized in the My112 app through a real-time tracking system.

outputs.description: Features include interactive map, GPS coordinates, and real-time updates.

name: provide_emergency_type_information
description: Details the types of emergencies classified in the My112 app and their importance.

outputs.description: Common types include traffic accidents, fires, choking incidents, cardiac arrests, home accidents, and medical emergencies.

name: provide_agency_information_and_status
description: Provides information about the agencies intervening in an emergency and their current status.

outputs.description: Includes identification of agencies, their current statuses, and real-time updates regarding their intervention.

name: provide_call_timestamp_information
description: Explains the significance of the date and time information recorded when a call is received by the My112 app.

outputs.description: Details the use of receipt timing for coordination, prioritization of interventions, and case tracking.

name: provide_real_time_tracking_info
description: Provides an overview of the real-time tracking functionality of the Mi Emergencia 112 application during emergencies, detailing information such as emergency type, call date and time, user location, and the statuses of responding agencies.

outputs.description: Real-time tracking of emergencies, including emergency type, call date and time, user location, and details about responding agencies and their statuses.

name: provide_sanitario_emergency_guide
description: The chatbot outlines key steps to take in the event of sanitary emergencies.

outputs.description: Steps include maintaining calm, calling 112, providing location and incident details.

name: provide_mi_emergencia_112_usage_guidelines
description: Provides comprehensive guidelines on how to download and utilize the Mi Emergencia 112 app during emergency situations, including detailed steps after calling 112.

outputs.description: Steps to follow after calling 112, detailing how to handle emergency situations via the app, including app features.

name: list_faqs_in_help_section
description: Provides examples of frequently asked questions found in the 'Help' section of the 'Mi Emergencia 112' app.

outputs.description: List of common questions related to the 'Mi Emergencia 112' app and its usage.

name: test_and_ensure_location_accuracy
description: Provides instructions for testing and ensuring the accuracy of the user's location within the app, including steps for verification and confirming permissions.

outputs.description: Instructions to verify location accuracy by confirming GPS and app permissions for reliable location tracking and comparing results with other services.

name: handle_internet_connection_loss
description: Provides guidance on what to do if the internet connection is lost while using the application.

outputs.description: Instructions for reconnecting and emergency call protocols.

name: confirm_es_alert_no_registration
description: Confirms to the user that no registration is necessary to receive alerts from the ES_ALERT system.

outputs.description: Information confirming that no registration is necessary to receive alerts.

name: list_additional_services
description: Lists additional services offered by the ES_ALERT system beyond public alerts, such as interactive voice response and precise mobile call localization.

outputs.description: Sistema de Respuesta Vocal Interactiva (IVR), Servicio de tracking de la app My112, Localización de llamadas móviles de alta precisión (AML), Aplicación Mi Emergencia 112

name: provide_app_download_guidance
description: Informs users about the availability of the My112 app on Android and iOS devices and provides instructions for downloading it.

outputs.description: Available on Google Play Store and App Store, with information about compatibility with Android and iOS systems, as well as download instructions.

name: provide_access_to_satisfaction_surveys
description: Provides links to access satisfaction survey reports and their methodologies from previous years.

outputs.description: URLs to satisfaction surveys and methodological reports for previous years and current surveys.

name: provide_specific_user_satisfaction_data
description: Provides access to data regarding user satisfaction specifically for family doctors.

outputs.description: Links to satisfaction survey reports regarding family doctors.

name: provide_nursing_professionals_satisfaction_statistics
description: Provides information on user satisfaction statistics specifically for nursing professionals.

outputs.description: Links to survey results and methodologies for nursing professionals.

name: provide_comparative_satisfaction_data
description: Allows comparison of satisfaction data between family doctors and nursing professionals through available surveys.

outputs.description: Links to satisfaction surveys that allow for comparison between the two professions.

name: list_available_health_services
description: Provides a list of various health services and benefits available to citizens in the Comunidad de Madrid.

outputs.description: Information on primary healthcare services, including emergency care, specialized services, mental health support, substance abuse treatment, vaccination points, and blood donation.

name: list_vaccination_programs
description: Lists current vaccination programs available in the Comunidad de Madrid.

outputs.description: Information on vaccination programs including child vaccination, adult vaccination, HPV vaccination for adolescents, vaccinations against more than 15 diseases, specific vaccinations for at-risk groups and special situations, and international vaccination for travelers.

name: provide_family_support_information
description: Information on the family support offered through addiction services.

outputs.description: Estrategias y consejos para aliviar el estrés, Información sobre prevención de consumo de drogas, Orientación y asesoramiento en el proceso de deshabituación, Actividades de formación para gestionar mejor la situación

name: list_health_promotion_programs
description: Provides details on health promotion programs available in schools.

outputs.description: Saludatuvida, Proyecto Desayunos Saludables e Higiene Bucodental, El Diario Saludable

name: provide_saludatuvida_details
description: Details the 'Saludatuvida' program focusing on promoting healthy habits among students.

outputs.description: Fomentar estilos de vida saludables, Actividad física, Alimentación, Salud emocional, Prevención de adicciones

name: list_other_health_education_programs
description: Lists other educational health programs available in schools.

outputs.description: Programa de Educación Afectivo-Sexual, Programa de Prevención de Adicciones, Programa de Alimentación Saludable

name: explain_program_access_steps
description: Explains the steps required for schools to access health education programs.

outputs.description: Cumplimentar formulario de preinscripción por el centro, Formulario de preinscripción individual por el docente, Compromiso para completar ambas fases del programa

name: provide_child_vaccination_information
description: Provides detailed information about the child vaccination program, including vaccination calendars and schedules for various vaccines based on age.

outputs.description: Includes details about vaccination administration timelines for various ages (e.g., at birth, 2-6 months, and 12 months) along with information on common vaccines such as Hepatitis B, DTPa, and Polio, as well as childhood vaccination schedules and calendars.

name: provide_information_on_travel_vaccines
description: Provides information on recommended vaccinations for youths traveling abroad.

outputs.description: Lists vaccines such as Hepatitis A, Yellow Fever, and others based on travel destinations.

name: prompt_for_access_to_location_info
description: Provides step-by-step instructions on how to access incident location information through the My112 app.

name: prompt_for_registration_steps
description: Provides detailed steps on how to register in the My112 app.

name: specify_required_personal_data_for_registration
description: Lists the personal data required to register in the My112 app.

name: explain_verification_code_process
description: Describes what type of verification code the user will receive upon registration.

name: provide_troubleshooting_steps_for_verification_code
description: Offers troubleshooting steps for issues related to verification codes, whether they do not work or are not received.

name: provide_contact_info_for_customer_support
description: Provides information on how to contact the customer support of My112.

name: inquire_language_assistance_options
description: Responds to the user's inquiry about language assistance availability in customer support.

name: explain_additional_functions_of_app
description: Explains additional features that the My112 app offers during emergencies.

outputs.description: Lists functions such as service tracking, high precision location, emergency tracking, and public alert system.

name: clarify_app_cost_information
description: Informs the user that the My112 app is free to download and use, while clarifying that potential data charges may apply when not connected to Wi-Fi.

outputs.description: Information on the app's cost structure and potential data charges.

name: prompt_for_location_tracking_activation_steps
description: Provides user instructions on activating location tracking within the My112 app.

outputs.description: Detailed steps to download the app, create an account, activate tracking, and confirm activation.

name: provide_accident_response_guidelines
description: The chatbot provides guidelines on how to respond in the event of a traffic accident with injuries.

outputs.description: Steps include mantener la calma, llamar al 112, no mover a los heridos, proporcionar primeros auxilios, and esperar ayuda.

name: list_basic_first_aid_steps
description: The chatbot lists steps for basic first aid that can be applied in case of a traffic accident with injuries.

outputs.description: Steps include evaluar la consciencia y respiración, realizar RCP, aplicar presión a hemorragias, and mantener a la persona tranquila.

name: provide_cpr_steps
description: The chatbot provides detailed steps for performing cardiopulmonary resuscitation (RCP).

outputs.description: Steps include verificar la consciencia, llamar al 112, verificar respiración, comenzar la RCP, and continuar hasta que llegue ayuda.

name: provide_post_cpr_guidelines
description: The chatbot provides guidelines on what to do if a person starts to respond or breathe after CPR.

outputs.description: Steps include colocar en posición de recuperación, mantener a la persona cómoda, no dejarla sola, and esperar ayuda.

name: provide_domestic_violence_response_guidelines
description: The chatbot provides guidelines for responding in a situation of domestic violence.

outputs.description: Steps include buscar apoyo, tener un plan de salida, no avisar al agresor, llamar al 112, and considerar protección legal.

name: list_types_of_protection_orders
description: The chatbot lists the types of protection orders available in cases of domestic violence.

outputs.description: Types include órdenes de alejamiento, órdenes de prohibición de comunicación, and órdenes de protección integral.

name: provide_information_on_support_services
description: The chatbot provides ways to find support services for victims of gender violence in Spain.

outputs.description: Resources include teléfono 012, centros de atención, and recursos online.

name: list_resources_on_madrid_health_support
description: The chatbot lists resources available on the web of the Comunidad de Madrid related to health and well-being.

outputs.description: Resources include Escuela Madrileña de Salud, teléfono 012, centros de salud, and programas de prevención.

name: list_prevention_programs_available
description: The chatbot provides information on various prevention programs offered through Madrid health resources.

outputs.description: Programs include Programa de Prevención de los Trastornos de la Conducta Alimentaria, talleres educativos, and jornadas municipales.

name: prompt_for_calling_steps
description: Provides users with steps to follow for making a call to 112 using the My112 app, including any relevant tracking information.

outputs.description: Steps to follow for making a call.
Information about real-time tracking of the emergency.

name: list_emergency_types_handled_by_service
description: Lists the different types of emergencies that can be reported through the app and the services that can attend to them.

outputs.description: Types of emergencies, including accidents, fires, medical emergencies, health, police, rescue, and situations of risk covered by the 112 service.

name: provide_alerts_information

outputs.description: Information regarding ES_ALERT public alert system in Madrid.

name: provide_usage_instructions

outputs.description: Information on guides for different types of emergencies like accidents and fires.

name: provide_guide_location_information
description: Informs where users can find the guides about emergency situations in the My112 app.

outputs.description: Instructions on locating the help or information section in the app.

name: prompt_for_app_update_steps
description: Guides users on how to update the My112 app on their devices.

outputs.description: Steps for updating the app through respective app stores.

name: provide_foreign_usage_information
description: Provides clarity on the usage of the app when the user is abroad.

outputs.description: Information regarding the app's functionality and handling emergencies while abroad.

name: provide_location_sharing_information
description: Informs users about the lack of location sharing features with other contacts during emergencies in the My112 app.

outputs.description: Details regarding automatic location sharing with emergency services instead of other contacts.

name: provide_notification_types
description: Lists the types of notifications that can be received regarding the emergency situation.

outputs.description: Includes Call Status, Real-time Updates, and Information about Responding Agencies.

name: provide_quick_access_options
description: Lists the quick access options available in the My112 app.

outputs.description: Options include Direct Access to 112, Precise Location, Real-time Tracking, and Notifications.

name: explain_access_direct_112_vs_precise_location
description: Differentiates between direct access to 112 and precise location features in the My112 app.

outputs.description: Explanation of access methods and their purposes.

outputs.description: Information about app functionality primarily designed for Spain, specifically the Community of Madrid.
